# Style notes

Keep sentences short. Prefer the active voice.

- Use plain words.
- If a term is unusual, explain it once.
- One idea per paragraph.

## Numbers

1. Spell out one to nine.

```text
1. A numbered line in a code block.
2. And a second one.
3. And a third.
```
